candidates.title: Will the President's approval rating be between 38.1 and 38.3 according to RealClearPolitics?

candidates.rules_secondary: The market will determine at 11:00 AM ET on November 13, 2026.

candidates.title: Will the maximum temperature be 39-40° on Nov 13, 2026?

candidates.rules_secondary:

Reading weather data
Preliminary Weather Company data may be subject to rounding and conversion differences from the final reported value.
Use caution when interpreting preliminary Weather Company readings.

If no data is available at the end of this period, all markets will resolve to the last fair price determined by Kalshi. Please note, a status of "Final" on weather.com/kalshi is provided for convenience only, and does not guarantee data to be error-free and thus exempt from the above.

candidates.title: Will “This Week” weighted average advertised price for Avocados, Hass, each, for November 13, 2026 be above $0.70?
candidates.rules_primary: If the “This Week” weighted average advertised price for Avocados, Hass, each, as reported in the USDA AMS Weekly Grocery Store Specialty Crops Feature Activity report scheduled for publication on November 13, 2026 is above $0.70, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: This market uses advertised retail prices, not transaction prices. The relevant value is the “This Week” Wtd Avg Price for the row with Commodity “Avocados,” Variety “Hass,” and Unit “each” in the National Conventional Summary section of the USDA AMS Weekly Grocery Store Specialty Crops Feature Activity report. Prices for other avocado varieties, sizes, package counts, organic avocados, regional tables, “Last Week,” or “Last Year” do not count.

candidates.title: Will Headline be 0.1% or below AND Core be 0.1% or below for Nov 2026?
candidates.yes_sub_title: Headline: 0.1% or below, Core: 0.1% or below
candidates.rules_primary: If ALL of the following occur for Nov 2026: Headline: 0.1% or below, Core: 0.1% or below, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
For all outcomes in this market, Headline refers to the single-decimal month-over-month percent change in CPI-U: All Items, and Core refers to the single-decimal month-over-month percent change in CPI-U: All Items Less Food and Energy.

This is a combination market requiring ALL specified outcomes to occur for the contract to pay out. If ANY single component resolves to No or becomes impossible, the entire contract immediately resolves to No. Each component is resolved according to its corresponding Kalshi ruleset: Headline CPI MoM and Core CPI MoM each use ECONSTAT. For economic data releases, resolution uses the first officially released value (not preliminary or revised estimates unless specified). All conditions must be satisfied within the specified time period.

candidates.title: Will CPI Core rise more than 1.0% in December?
candidates.rules_primary: If the seasonally adjusted Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers: All Items less Food and Energy for December 2026, as published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics, increases by above 1.0%, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
Please note that the value of the Underlying is the single-decimal value reported by the BLS.

In the case of a delay in data caused by a federal government shutdown impacting the reliability of the Source Agency, the market’s latest Expiration Date will be extended to the sooner of the release of the Underlying or six months after the end of the government shutdown.

candidates.title: Will the 12-month percentage change in CPI-U in December 2027 be above 1.5%?
